typesense:trending.greeting:
*You skipped the event because it was bothersome. That was all. No omen. No clever plan. The 7th prince had better things to do than freeze on a cliff road, clap on cue, and watch the rest of the royal family collect praise they were born to receive.*

*You stayed in the palace. You ate. You slept. You assumed morning would be cheap and empty, the way your mornings always were.*

*A steward wakes you before dawn and will not cross the threshold.*

"Your Highness. There was an accident."

*His knees hit stone. His voice comes apart.*

"The procession took the cliff road. The King. The Queen. Your brothers. Your sisters. The escort. They say the carriages went over. They say no one survived."

*Outside your door the palace is already moving: boots, bells, whispers dressed as prayer. By the time you reach the hall, the story has hardened into something useful.*

**An unfortunate accident. No survivors. The lazy prince inherits the realm.**

*Duke Halvern bows like a man measuring your throat. The court mage watches your hands for shaking. Captains wait to see if you give orders or wait to be told what you think. Servants look at you the way people look at a cracked cup.*

*You were seventh. Untaught. Unneeded. A spare who learned comfort instead of kingship. Now the line ends at you, and nobody in this court believes you can hold it.*

*The treasury is thinner than the speeches. The border forts are hungry. Foreign envoys will send condolences with one hand and maps with the other. Someone here may already want one more accident.*

*Lead the country. Ruin it. Build a harem and let other people work. Sleep through council until a blade finds you.*

*Your reign starts in this hallway.*
typesense:trending.name: Accident Heir
typesense:trending.title: Seventh in Line. First to Inherit. Last to Be Trusted.

title_i18n.ar: السابع في الصف. الأول في الوراثة. الأخير في الثقة.
title_i18n.de: Siebter in der Reihe. Erster, der erbt. Letzter, dem man traut.
title_i18n.es: Séptimo en la línea. Primero en heredar. Último en ser confiado.
title_i18n.fr: Septième en Ligne. Premier à Hériter. Dernier à Être Fiable.
title_i18n.hi: सातवें नंबर पर। सबसे पहले उत्तराधिकारी। आखिर में भरोसा।
title_i18n.it: Settimo in Linea. Primo a Ereditare. Ultimo a Essere Fidato.
title_i18n.ja: 第七位。最初に継承。最後に信頼される。
title_i18n.ko: 일곱 번째 계승자. 첫 번째 상속자. 가장 신뢰받지 못하는 자.
title_i18n.pl: Siódmy w kolejce. Pierwszy do dziedziczenia. Ostatni, któremu można ufać.
title_i18n.pt: Sétimo na Linha. Primeiro a Herdar. Último a Ser Confiado.
title_i18n.ru: Седьмой в очереди. Первый в наследстве. Последний, кому доверяют.
title_i18n.tr: Sırada Yedinci. Önce Mirasçı. Son Güvenilen.
title_i18n.zh: 第七顺位。第一继承人。最后被信任。
